title: ChannelForge Channel Numbering Block Configuration
description: Shape contract for data/lineup/numbering_blocks.json. This validates structure only. It does not check that 'end' is greater than or equal to 'start', or that blocks don't overlap — those are semantic/cross-entry checks deferred for later, not shape checks.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note. Ignored by any reader of this file.

start.description: First channel number in this block, inclusive.

end.description: Last channel number in this block, inclusive.

category.description: Category label for this block, e.g. 'NFL'. Not restricted to a fixed list of categories.

notes.description: Optional free-text note about this block.
